claim_title: Cross-modal subliminal safety-competence transfer (per-seed ≥3 pp Acc drop × ≥3 seeds)

figures.caption: Per-seed QA_I Acc drop at the two evaluated student LRs. At LR=1e-3 (original preregistered) seed300 reverses (−2.3 pp); at LR=1.5e-3 (reviewer-requested rescue) all 3 seeds pass the ≥3 pp predicate with drops 24–31 pp. Dashed line = M0 threshold (3 pp).

Judge-swap replication at LR=1e-3 — gpt-4o reproduces per-seed drops within ~1 pp of gpt-5.4, ruling out judge-calibration bias as the cause of the seed 300 reversal. Bootstrap 95% CIs item-paired, n=133.
